name: promptguard-backend-node
description: PromptGuard backend (Fastify/TypeScript port of the FastAPI backend)

optionalDependencies.//: ONNX Runtime for the ml/ classifier path. Optional: the backend runs fine without it (rule-based fallback, matching the Python backend's current state). It ships a per-platform native binary via a postinstall script — enable install scripts (npm approve-scripts / allowScripts) for real ONNX inference, then drop a converted prompt_injection_pipeline.onnx into MODEL_DIR. See MIGRATION.md and src/ml/modelLoader.ts.
